title: Catalog filter list markup and language button label fail WCAG 2.1 AA
steps: Open https://practicesoftwaretesting.com and run an axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA scan.
Open a product page and run the same scan.
Compare the reported violations with the expected clean result.
expectedResult: The automated scan reports no WCAG 2.1 AA violations on either page.
actualResult: axe-core 4.13.0 reports 2 serious violations on the home page and 1 on the product page. 'list' (WCAG 1.3.1): a <fieldset> is a direct child of <ul> in the category filter. 'label-content-name-mismatch' (WCAG 2.5.3, experimental rule): button #language has aria-label 'Select language' that does not contain its visible text. Colour-contrast checks were uncertain (2 on home, 3 on product) and need a manual check.
